ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a solid composed of triangular faces, with five vertices. The top vertex is labeled 1, and the left vertex is labeled 5. There are also three unlabeled vertices: the front vertex slightly to the right of the middle, the rear vertex on the right side, and the bottom vertex. There is a dashed line from the left vertex to the rear vertex on the right side, indicating a hidden edge; overall it can be read as a triangular bipyramid, with the top and bottom two pointed vertices connected to the same triangular base. Reasoning: According to the method, set the top vertex as T=1, the left vertex as L=5, and the three unknown vertices as C, R, B respectively, where C is the middle/front vertex, R is the right/rear vertex, and B is the bottom vertex. The three upper faces of this triangular bipyramid are T-L-C, T-C-R, T-R-L, and the three lower faces are B-L-C, B-C-R, B-R-L. Let the sum of the vertices of each triangular face be S. From the three upper faces we get: 1+5+C=S, 1+C+R=S, 1+R+5=S. Comparing 1+5+C=S and 1+C+R=S gives R=5. Comparing 1+C+R=S and 1+R+5=S gives C=5. Therefore S=1+5+5=11. Then look at the lower face B-L-C: B+5+5=11, so B=1. The sum of the three unwritten numbers is C+R+B=5+5+1=11.
